result.summary: The page renders mostly correctly, but there is a data-formatting bug in the 'Fastest near you' carousel where a delivery fee shows as NaN, plus a minor inconsistency in favorite button styling.

issues.description: The 'Smash Bros Burgers' card shows '€NaN delivery' instead of a real delivery fee, indicating a missing/invalid numeric value being formatted as currency.
issues.suggestion: Guard the price formatter against null/undefined/non-numeric values and fall back to 'Free delivery' or hide the fee line when data is unavailable.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) buttons on the two 'Popular right now' cards use inconsistent styling: the first has a white circular background with a dark outline heart, while the second has a dark/transparent background with a white heart.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite button background and icon color across all restaurant cards, ensuring sufficient contrast over any image.
